Arranger and producer Charlie Calello has played an integral role in iconic recordings since the mid-1960s. He has collaborated with The Four Seasons, Neil Diamond, Bruce Springsteen, and most recently Joe Bwarie.
Charlie was interviewed on July 21, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
